subject: Behavioral Economics
title: The Availability Cascade
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Availability Cascade.

hook.text: A rare disease gets media attention. Suddenly everyone thinks it's an epidemic. Nothing changed.

buildup.text: Repeated media coverage makes events feel common. Each story triggers more stories, feeding the loop.

discovery.text: An availability cascade: belief spreads because the idea is repeated, not because it's true.

twist.text: Public fear then drives policy changes for a threat that remains statistically tiny.

climax.text: The volume of a story determines its perceived importance. Frequency of mention beats actual frequency.

quiz.question: What drives an availability cascade?
options: Repeated mention making an idea feel common
